label: D1 fixation step with moderate a2 preference and low value
explanation: Fires only at D1 (fixation, prior reward shown); never at GO or D2. Within D1 it is almost exclusively on trials where the agent will choose a2 (99% of mass; action==2 at D1 gives recall 0.99 but precision 0.28). Prev reward does not matter. It is gated further by the model state: policy logit(a1)-logit(a2) moderately negative (about -9 to -1.5; it is silent when a2 preference is extreme) and low value-head output (silent above value ~7.7). Rate rises late in the episode (trials 80-99) and after a rare transition on the previous a2 trial (prev_common==0 has precision 0.60). Activation tends to build up over consecutive a2 trials in a window. Recorded predicate uses model readouts (choice logit, value) at D1, which are observable; the alternative with the upcoming choice, (phase==D1)&(action==2)&(value<7.5), gives dev F1 0.54. Best dev F1 0.60, recall 0.83, precision 0.46: a D1 unit for a moderate, uncertain a2 preference, with magnitude carried by graded internal state.
